newsitem.title: USA: BFX sees Q3 net EPS of about $0.083.
newsitem.headline: BFX sees Q3 net EPS of about $0.083.

text.p: BFX Hospitality Group Inc said Monday it expects to report third quarter earnings of about $6.3 million, or $0.83 per share.

The projections for that quarter, ended June 30, include income from discontinued operations of about $12.8 million, or $1.68 per share, resulting from the operations and previously announced sale of Current Technology Inc. The sale was effective May 31.
Also included in the anticipated current quarter results is a loss from continuing operations of about $6.5 million, or $0.85 per share, the company said.
Chief Executive Robert McLean said in a statement that the loss from continuing operations should be about $9.9 million before taxes.

He said it primarily results from charges of about $4.4 million related to the previously announced remedy in connection with the company's Bestal, New York Superfund site, acquisition costs related to Hotels of Distinction Inc, certain concept development expenditures and a reserve for the collection of certain notes receivable.
